race.title: Racing TV Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: POETS WHISPER picked up in striking fashion once the penny dropped to win a Kelso bumper in the spring and is taken to follow up now hurdling. Noel Kelly's new recruit Tyson Fury has placed several times in similar races already this season and should figure again. Teeshan hasn't been seen since finishing down the field in the Champion Bumper at the 2024 Cheltenham Festival but would still very much enter the reckoning should the betting vibes be strong on this return for Dan Skelton. POETS WHISPER (IRE) TYSON FURY TEESHAN (IRE)
